data.one_liner: Simple and extensible logging API with support for custom plugins.
data.what_it_does: Lumberdash provides a simple logging API to record logs like warnings, errors, messages, and fatal events. It allows you to initialize multiple logging clients simultaneously or create your own custom plugins.
use_when: You need a pluggable logging solution for your application.
You want to send logs to multiple destinations like stdout, Firebase, or Sentry at the same time.
avoid_when: You require an advanced built-in log viewer UI inside the app.
strengths: Extensible architecture through custom Lumberdash clients
Support for multiple concurrent logging clients
Officially supported plugins for popular services like Firebase and Sentry
weaknesses: Relies on external plugins for actual log formatting or backend integration
data.setup_notes: Add lumberdash to dependencies and call putLumberdashToWork with desired clients in main().
